_doc: Challenges the council proposes (challenges.gd; make_it_fun F). From from_day, every offer_every_days when none is running or waiting, the first in list not yet met, failed or declined whose when holds (story conditions) is proposed as a dilemma (title, text: who speaks, say, desc, reward_text). Taken up, it is met when goal holds (story conditions, plus deaths_since / outposts_since: counted from when it was taken up) and fails when fail does; days or until (a season's name: when it next begins) is the time it has. hold: true means the goal must still hold when time is up ("no one dies this winter": nothing fails it until spring, then it is met). reward / penalty: story actions. A met challenge is an achievement (met_feat).
title: The Council Proposes
text: %s rises at the council fire: "%s" %s If we do it: %s
taken_log: The tribe takes up a challenge: %s.
declined_log: The council lets the challenge pass.

list.title: No one dies this winter
list.say: Let us swear that the cold takes no one this year.
list.desc: From now until spring, no one of the tribe may die.

list.title: A friend among the clans
list.say: We have neighbours. Let one of them call us friend before the new age comes.
list.desc: Win the friendship of a clan (Friendly or better) before the second age.

list.title: A hearth across the river
list.say: Our people are many. Let us raise a second hearth on new land within four days.
list.desc: Found an outpost (a settlement contract completed) within 4 days.

list.title: Full stores before the frost
list.say: The land is generous now. Let us fill the stores before winter comes.
list.desc: Fill the food stores to nine tenths before winter begins.

list.title: A house for the spirits
list.say: The spirits have only a pole of wood. Let us raise them a temple before the next age.
list.desc: Build a temple before the third age.
